messages:
erin: Heads-up — shaping a Q3 playbook for gentle version locks and customer opt‑in migrations. Need alignment on: version-lock semantics, deprecation windows, canary vs opt-in migration paths, and benchmark gates. Thoughts?

sam: +1. My draft: "version-lock" = per-model temporary freeze that prevents automatic rollouts for N days but still allows emergency overrides. Default N=14.

priya: From CS: customers expect at least 30 days notice for tokenizer/embedding-affecting changes. Also need an explicit rollback link in the console.

noah: Eng note: we can do per-tenant routing + rollback. Main risk = KV cache invalidation during major model swaps — could spike cost. Suggest auto-throttle and backoff on cache misses.

erin: Proposal: two-tier deprecation windows — "soft" (30d) and "hard" (90d). Soft = flag as deprecated but pinned customers keep serving unchanged. Hard = remove model from default catalog and begin migration enforcement.

sam: example policy snippet:
```json
{"policy": "deprecation", "soft_days": 30, "hard_days": 90, "lock_default_days": 14, "override_roles": ["sre","platform"]}
```

catalog-bot: note added: deprecation-policy-q3 -> /docs/catalog/deprecation-policy-v3 (auto) :page_with_curl:

ops: telemetry items to emit: catalog.deprecation.started, catalog.deprecation.soft_warning, catalog.migration.canary_start, catalog.lock.applied. Hook these to CostAlerts and RollbackPlaybook.

priya: Comms checklist: 1) migration guide, 2) per-customer test token & migration sandbox, 3) migration credits for high-touch customers, 4) clear fallback instructions.

noah: Benchmark gates suggestion: latency <= 1.2x baseline AND quality delta <= 2% on our standard eval set (intent+summaries). If either fails, promote to manual review and extended canary.

erin: Agreed. Action items: sam -> demo per-tenant canary routing + freeze toggle by next Wed (1991234999). priya -> customer comms draft by EOD Fri. noah -> benchmark suite + load test plan. ops -> add telemetry hooks.

sam: on it.

catalog-bot: scheduled canary run: 1991234800 (canary-run-id: cr-1991234800)

priya: small ask — add an opt-in migration checkbox in the Console so customers can elect new default but keep pinned instance during migration window.

erin: Good call. We'll add to scope as optional self-serve migration flow.

noah: FYI: I'll include a small synthetic load test to measure KV miss cost delta; expects ~15% token cost bump worst-case.

erin: Thanks all — we'll iterate on the doc. If no objections, I'll start the formal playbook write-up and lifecycle page. :sparkles:
